ns0:g.ns0:text: Measurement bandwidth limits magnitude fidelity and phase fidelity

ns0:text.ns0:tspan: ). Shading 0.1–1 Hz illustrates a stricter usable band, not a universal bandwidth rule. For a selected signal band f
with margin; the analog anti-alias filter must adequately attenuate content at and above f
/2. Sensor roll-off alone may be insufficient.
